integrator: RK4 + Kahan-Neumaier backward Dyson (verbatim replica of src/math/dyson-ode-integrator.js rk4StepKahan, imp-306/imp-363); collision gate raw spacing < 1e-4; t_c = step * dt at first sub-gate step
dtPolicy: dt = min(5e-4, tau_c_est(N) / 300) — the imp-859 fixed dt = 5e-4 exceeds tau_c_est(N) near N = 10^4, so a per-N dt is physically required; each N re-run at dt/2 as a step-halving self-consistency check
